bio: Rehearsing 8 hours a day. Bach and Chopin understand me better than people do.

nodes.partnerMessage: Greetings, {PlayerName}. I took a brief break between concertos to see who matched with me.

choices.choiceText: Must take intense discipline to practice that long.
Ever play something with a breakdown or beat?

nodes.partnerMessage: Finally, someone who grasps the devotion required. Silence and acoustics are everything to me.

choices.choiceText: Can I listen to you rehearse?

nodes.partnerMessage: Modern rhythms lack dynamic breath, but I appreciate raw boldness. Texting cannot convey tone.
Tap my private studio link. OnlyYaps has high-fidelity audio rooms where we can speak properly.
